The staff stays gripped by the correct hand; asymmetric slit/hand must stay anatomical across actual views, not mirrored shortcuts.

Rows1-2 are neutral IDLE A eight views: row1 columns E/right profile, SE/front-right, S/front, SW/front-left; row2 columns W/left profile, NW/rear-left, N/full back, NE/rear-right. Keep wings gracefully partly folded behind her without covering both lower legs; no wing flapping that lifts her into the air. In idleB shift weight to the other supporting leg through knees/pelvis and shoulders while feet remain planted and staff grip attached. Keep full crown spikes, hair tips, every feather, gown hem, staff head/bottom and boot toes completely inside each cell with VERY generous clear padding around the entire maximum silhouette. No neighboring-figure overlap or body bounds that include another figure. Shrink figures inside their cells rather than crop feathers/staff. REAL transparent alpha0 outside each complete continuous character. No loose feathers, particles, magical haze, floor, shadow, background, text, grid, labels or detached ornaments. Thin connected rim light is okay. Source-only; clean whole figures for animation authoring, exactly16.
